heroHeadline: EU Wildfire Total Climbs to 646,628 Hectares as Cernavodă Stays Offline Into September
heroSubtitle: EFFIS puts the EU's cumulative 2026 burned area at 646,628 hectares as of 1 September, still trailing 2025's record pace but far above the long-term average, while Romania's energy-sector state of alert remains in force through 30 September with both Cernavodă reactors still shut and Danube flow forecasts fluctuating well below the historical average.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
